predictions.guard_summary: Conditional check: this.newer && st.mtime > entry.mtime. The 'newer' option must be enabled and existing file must have newer modification time.
predictions.risk_pattern: Archive extraction skips updating files when existing files are newer, potentially preventing security updates or allowing outdated/insecure files to persist
called_function_context: SKIPNEWER: decrements pending counter and resumes entry stream
enclosing_conditions: Existing file modification time > archive entry modification time
predictions.context_summary: Called during file system check when unpacking archive entries. When newer option is set and existing file is newer than archive version, extraction is skipped entirely for that file.
unresolved_facts: Specific security impact depends on archive source and context of use
Whether skipping newer files is intentional security feature or potential bypass mechanism
